title: How to Decide Whether Voice Design Fits Your Next Character
markdown:
If you already have a specific voice in mind but cannot find a suitable option in a voice library, Voice Design is worth evaluating as a prompt-led alternative. ElevenLabs describes it as a way to create a unique voice by describing the characteristics you need in text, and positions it for filling gaps when the available Voice Library voices do not fit the vision. [ElevenLabs Voice Design](https://elevenlabs.io/voice-design)

Start with the creative brief, not a generic label. Specify the character’s role, age range, accent, pitch, pacing, emotional tone, and delivery direction. ElevenLabs says the tool lets users customize tone, accent, age, pacing, and delivery, and its page describes controls for age, gender, pitch, emotion, delivery, overall direction, audio quality, and preview text. [ElevenLabs Voice Design](https://elevenlabs.io/voice-design)

A practical decision test is to write one concise prompt, choose a short preview line that exposes the qualities you care about, then assess whether the result serves the character and script. If it does not, revise the description rather than assuming a broad phrase such as “friendly narrator” communicates enough direction. For prompt examples and guidance, ElevenLabs links to its Voice Design prompting guide. [ElevenLabs Voice Design](https://elevenlabs.io/voice-design)

Consider Voice Design when you need a character voice or a realistic voice with a particular combination of traits. ElevenLabs gives examples in both categories and says Professional Voice Clones remain the platform’s highest-quality voices; when a suitable one is available, it recommends using it. [ElevenLabs Voice Design](https://elevenlabs.io/voice-design)

For a low-commitment evaluation, the pricing page lists Voice Design on the Free plan, which is listed at $0 per month with 10,000 credits per month. The same page says credits are shared across products, so check remaining credits if you also use other ElevenLabs tools. Prices exclude taxes, levies, and duties. [ElevenLabs pricing](https://elevenlabs.io/pricing)

If you later need a paid plan, the listed monthly Starter price is $6 with 30,000 credits, while Creator is listed at $22 per month with a $11 first month offer; review the current plan page before deciding because plan details and billing options are presented there. [ElevenLabs pricing](https://elevenlabs.io/pricing)

Disclosure: This article contains an affiliate link.

Ready to evaluate whether a text-described voice can fill your character gap? [Try Voice Design](https://try.elevenlabs.io/elevenlabs-discovered-voice-design-en-1)
